core.note: Full core run predates the separate one-line correlated VALUES emission fix; its SQL regressions passed after that change.

working_tree_note: All runtime validation used the combined working tree, which includes the deferred uncommitted UPDATE FROM changes. Those changes are excluded from this commit. The user-staged prompt and papers are excluded.
remaining: Correlated membership, expression-valued membership, scalar outputs, full domain unnesting, shared CTE identity repair, final branch performance and broader integration remain unfinished.
